claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if FY27 Photonics-SOI revenue fails to grow materially versus the >$100m FY26 base (watch FY27 half-year results), or if CPO qualification volumes do not convert to production orders within two fiscal halves.
claims.statement: Soitec's official FY26 results quantify the Photonics-SOI business at above $100m revenue with volumes already shipping for CPO industry qualifications ahead of the ramp. This upgrades the August capacity-reservation narrative from a Reuters interview to the company's regulated financial communication, and quantifies the segment. Still supplier self-report: no customer is named anywhere, so external corroboration remains missing — the upgrade path stays a named customer or statutory contract-liabilities disclosure tied to the reservation deposits.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Soitec FY27 半年報（約 2026 年 11 月）的 Photonics-SOI 營收沒有較 FY26 成長，或 CPO 驗證出貨沒有轉成量產訂單，或客戶端／第三方一手文件寫出另一家 SOI 晶圓廠在 Photonics-SOI 量產供貨。核查頻率：每半年（Soitec 半年報與年報）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 降 confidence，重讀 Photonics-SOI 層。
claims.statement: Soitec's own FY26 results release: Photonics-SOI revenue was 'above $100m in FY26', driven by 'increasing Photonics-SOI penetration in high-speed pluggable transceivers and growing volumes shipped for co-packaged optics (CPOs) industry qualifications, in preparation for the upcoming ramp-up'. Modeled as Soitec supplying a Photonics-SOI substrate layer that is a component of pluggable transceivers and (in qualification) CPO. Supplier self-report (L8): no customer is named. Whether other SOI wafer makers supply Photonics-SOI at volume was not searched in this package — 'not found' is not 'does not exist' (L11-5).

sources.quote: Strong momentum in Photonics-SOI, a powerful growth driver addressing surging AI data center demand, with revenue above $100m in FY26

AI commercial momentum remains strong, driven by increasing Photonics-SOI penetration in high-speed pluggable transceivers and growing volumes shipped for co-packaged optics (CPOs) industry qualifications, in preparation for the upcoming ramp-up.

Soitec’s ability to deliver high-end and differentiated products to AI infrastructure value chain supports the Group’s strong position in pluggable transceivers and growing traction from co-packaged optics architectures.
